queries.name: rows
queries.sql: SELECT "<COLUMN ID: Line Item>" AS "Line Item", "<COLUMN ID: Baseline Rate>" AS "Baseline Rate", "<COLUMN ID: Override Rate>" AS "Override Rate", "<COLUMN ID: Rationale>" AS "Rationale", "<COLUMN ID: Effective Rate>" AS "Effective Rate" FROM "workbook"."<ELEMENT ID>" ORDER BY 1

queries.name: distinct_keys
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "row_count", COUNT(DISTINCT "<COLUMN ID: Line Item>") AS "distinct_keys" FROM "workbook"."<ELEMENT ID>"

queries.name: non_null_editable
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT("<COLUMN ID: Override Rate>") AS "Override Rate non-null", COUNT("<COLUMN ID: Rationale>") AS "Rationale non-null" FROM "workbook"."<ELEMENT ID>"

queries.name: sums
queries.sql: SELECT SUM("<COLUMN ID: Override Rate>") AS "Override Rate sum", SUM("<COLUMN ID: Baseline Rate>") AS "Baseline Rate sum", SUM("<COLUMN ID: Effective Rate>") AS "Effective Rate sum" FROM "workbook"."<ELEMENT ID>"

queries.name: seeded_rows
queries.sql: SELECT "<COLUMN ID: Line Item>" AS "Line Item", "<COLUMN ID: Baseline Rate>" AS "Baseline Rate", "<COLUMN ID: Override Rate>" AS "Override Rate", "<COLUMN ID: Rationale>" AS "Rationale", "<COLUMN ID: Effective Rate>" AS "Effective Rate" FROM "workbook"."<ELEMENT ID>" WHERE "<COLUMN ID: Line Item>" IN ('Subscription - Enterprise', 'Cloud Hosting') ORDER BY 1

expected.oneRowPerKey: row_count must equal distinct_keys; both equal the source's distinct key count
expected.note: expected sums assume the editable columns were empty before the seed
